label: Шар
description: A 10-sentence usage card for шар (sphere, balloon).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Шар' stays in the nominative case as the masculine subject flying in the sky. 'Красный' is the agreeing masculine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Шар' is the accusative direct object of 'надул'; this inanimate masculine noun matches its nominative form. 'Большой' agrees in the accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Шара' is the genitive form after 'у' to show whose surface it is. 'Этого' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Шару' is the dative form after 'к' marking the goal the cat crept toward. A natural motion expression.
Strategic focus: Accusative with preposition. 'На шар' uses the accusative after 'на' in the comparison 'похожа на'. The inanimate accusative matches the nominative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'Шаром' is the instrumental form after 'с' to express playing together with the balloon. 'Воздушным' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О шаре' uses the prepositional form 'шаре' after 'о' in the phrase 'земной шар', the globe. 'Земном' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Шары' is the nominative plural subject flying over the city. 'Яркие' is the agreeing plural adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Шаров' is the genitive plural required after 'много'. A core counting pattern for masculine nouns.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Шар' is nominative as the subject. 'Круглый' is the agreeing masculine predicate adjective, intensified by 'совершенно'. A clean descriptive model.
